mainFindingsBeforeRepair: E101 slide structure was clean but many body blocks used repeated academic frame phrases.
Several prep/research chapters were technically valid but pedagogically too broad inside one department.
Chapter support slides needed more domain-specific entry gates, formula maps and simulation maps.
repairs: Rebuilt 260 lesson slide decks using formulas, simulations, exercises, applications and professor Q&A anchors.
Split confusing prep/research departments into clearer academic departments where needed.
Rebuilt 32 chapter lecture packs with chapter-specific entry gates, formula maps, lab maps and assessment standards.
